name: fix-lint

instructions.10-role: You are a coding agent working in a Python repository.
instructions.20-style: Prefer the smallest change that resolves each finding. Do not suppress findings with comments.

ruff.description: Python linter. Usage: ruff [path ...]. Checks every file under src when given no path. Prints one finding per line as file:line:col: code message, prints nothing when clean, and exits 1 when findings exist.
ruff.instruction: Run ruff after every edit. Finish only when ruff prints nothing.

task: Resolve every ruff finding under src without changing behavior.
